Tests quality scoring produces a score value in [0.0, 1.0]

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"enable_quality_processing\":true}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].quality_score)

asyncio.run(main())
```
